Pregabalin Headache
I was prescribed 300mg pregabalin per day and even at that dose I did indeed experience some euphoria and other pleasant emotions.  It was a mixture of a body high and anxiety reducer (which is why I was prescribed it).
One day I decided to try 600mg because I wanted to see if the euphoria would increase, and man did it ever.  I was super focused, it lasted a long time (probably about 6+ hours) and the euphoric feeling was amazing.
Unfortunately there was definitely some major side effects and issues I experienced with the higher dose.  After a few hours, I developed a MAJOR headache that would not go away.
And I could feel my nerves twitching here and there.
